summary: Founder Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K and press release announcing a 100-for-1 share consolidation of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective September 1, 2026, to regain compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price rule 5550(a)(2). Pre-consolidation, 7,369,159 Class A and 186,358 Class B shares were outstanding; post-consolidation these become approximately 73,693 and 1,865 shares. The shares continue trading under symbol FGL with a new CUSIP. Fractional shares are rounded up via bonus shares. This is a routine capital-structure change, not a special situation; watch for Nasdaq compliance confirmation.
